nodes.description: address public owner of AirDropContract, used as the authorization anchor and as the destination of token withdrawals
drop(address,address[],uint256[]) public: owner-gated airdrop that loops over recipients and calls token.transferFrom
isQualitifiedAddress(address) public view: filters out zero address, caller address and contract addresses
isContract(address) internal view: uses inline assembly extcodesize to detect contracts
fallback payable function that unconditionally reverts
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint256) public: withdraws arbitrary ERC20 tokens to owner without any caller authorization
msg.sender inside drop(), compared to owner and used as source of token transfers
msg.sender inside isQualitifiedAddress(), used to exclude the caller from receiving an airdrop

external call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, recipients[i], amounts[i]) executed inside an unbounded loop on an untrusted token
external call ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) reachable by any caller with no access control
inline assembly block reading extcodesize(addr) without higher-level safety checks

edges.reason: owner state variable is read in require(msg.sender == owner) to gate drop()
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorize the airdrop loop
drop() calls isQualitifiedAddress for each recipient
isQualitifiedAddress calls isContract(addr)
drop() invokes token.balanceOf on the supplied token contract
drop() invokes token.allowance on the supplied token contract
drop() invokes token.transferFrom inside the recipient loop
msg.sender is passed as the account argument to token.balanceOf
msg.sender is passed as the owner argument to token.allowance
msg.sender is used as the from argument of the external transferFrom call made on an untrusted token
ERC20 interface instance token is used to perform balanceOf
ERC20 interface instance token is used to perform allowance
ERC20 interface instance token is used to perform transferFrom
balanceOf return value is stored in local balance
allowance return value is stored in local allowance
balance participates in the ternary computing available
allowance participates in the ternary computing available
available is compared and decremented (available -= amounts[i]) under the loop in drop
loop index i controls each transferFrom invocation
recipients[i] is passed as addr to isQualitifiedAddress
recipients[i] is used as the to argument of transferFrom
amounts[i] is used as the value argument of transferFrom
require(available >= amounts[i]) guards the arithmetic before transferFrom is executed
external call to an attacker-controlled token can re-enter drop() while the loop is still running
addr parameter is checked in isQualitifiedAddress
msg.sender is compared inside isQualitifiedAddress to exclude the caller
addr parameter is consumed by the extcodesize assembly in isContract
isContract executes the inline assembly extcodesize block
assembly assigns extcodesize(addr) to local size
size > 0 determines the boolean returned by isContract
transferAnyERC20Token calls ERC20.transfer on the supplied token
tokenAddress parameter is cast into the ERC20 interface inside transferAnyERC20Token
tokens parameter is forwarded as the transfer amount
owner is the destination of the transfer but no msg.sender check protects transferAnyERC20Token, letting anyone drain tokens to owner
ERC20.transfer return value is returned as success
